title: Above the Clouds
story: A mountain ridge lit pink at the end of the day, rising out of a river of cloud above the dark line of the forest.
story_cs: Horský hřeben zbarvený do růžova na konci dne, vystupující z řeky mraků nad tmavou linií lesa.

mockups.alt: A framed print of a mountain range rising above clouds, hanging over a light wooden sideboard
A framed print of a mountain range in pink evening light, with window shadows falling across it
